options.label: warps
options.rule:
Complete the game in the fastest time. Warps are allowed.
NTSC region of a game ROM is assumed.

options.label: PAL, warps
options.rule:
The game ROM of PAL (Europe) region must be used.
Complete the game in the fastest time. Warps are allowed.

options.label: warps, walkathon
options.rule: Complete the game in the fastest time without running. Warps are allowed.

options.label: warpless
options.rule: Complete the game in the fastest time without using warps.

options.label: warpless, walkathon
options.rule: Complete the game in the fastest time without running. Warps are not allowed.

options.label: maximum coins
options.rule: Complete the game in the fastest time while collecting the maximum amount of coins possible.

options.label: 000000 points
options.rule: Finish the game with 000000 points (by overflowing the edge of 9999950 points)

options.label: all items
options.rule: Complete the game in the fastest time while collecting every mushroom/flower, star, and 1-up.

options.label: minimum A presses
options.rule: Complete the game in the fastest time while pressing A in the minimum amount possible.
